title: Paul McCartney live: Estádio Couto Pereira, Curitiba | 2019
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Estádio Couto Pereira in Curitiba, Brazil, on 30 March 2019.

It was the 23rd show of the Freshen Up Tour, which lasted for 39 dates between September 2018 and July 2019. This concert was seen by 41,609 fans.

https://twitter.com/JohnFernandini/status/1112337692052938754

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).

McCartney returned to the Estádio Couto Pereira on 13 December 2023 during the Got Back Tour.
